reasons.nonconformance|a composite_shape_aspect: PMI practice §6.4 writes several features taken together as a composite_group_shape_aspect named 'multiple elements' (or 'pattern of features', §6.4.1); these files (CATIA exports) write a plain composite_shape_aspect with that string. The string states the meaning, so it is read as that group, reported.
reasons.nonconformance|a group without members;: A composite_group_shape_aspect with no member relationship (NIST STC-07 #14072): a group of nothing is not a feature.
reasons.nonconformance|a property on a shape asp: Notes (semantic text, CATIA 'NOTE' aspects) attached to a shape aspect that names no geometry (e.g. NIST CTC-02 #22163, the drawing's general notes). There is no feature to hold them on; they are read as on the part, reported.
reasons.nonconformance|composite_group_shape_asp: NIST FTC-09 writes composite_group_shape_aspects with empty name and description; §6.4 requires one of the two strings. Read as a group of unstated kind (GroupKind::Unstated), not guessed.
reasons.nonconformance|duplicate source identifi: STC06 repeats general property on 440 distinct property definitions; STC09 repeats mass property on 16. The reader now reports these source identifier collisions without refusing native PMI or JSON export. All carriers and ID_ATTRIBUTE instances are named; original identifiers remain metadata and repeated wire ids fall back to content ids. Structural coverage: pmi_xcaf_read.rs.
reasons.nonconformance|limits_and_fits form_vari: NIST FTC-10's LIMITS_AND_FITS('G6','hole','','') puts the grade in form_variance (§5.2.5: form_variance is the fundamental deviation, grade the grade); read as G6, reported (the drawing states ⌀3.50 G6).
reasons.nonconformance|shape aspect identifies n: Shape aspects with no item usage (no GISU or IIRU) and no members: CATIA 'GDT'/'DIMENSION' placeholders linked only to presentation, and default model views' aspects. With nothing identified there is no feature; items built on them are reported separately.
reasons.nonconformance|the datum feature identif: CATIA files put the datum feature's face usage on the DATUM (e.g. NIST CTC-02 #661 on datum D #128) and none on the DATUM_FEATURE; §6.5.1 Figure 36 puts it on the datum feature. Read as the datum feature's faces, reported.
reasons.nonconformance|type N dimension modifier: §5.3 names the compound item of type 2 modifiers 'modifiers'; these files name it 'dimensional note' or 'dimension modifiers type 2' (with a SET_REPRESENTATION_ITEM). Its items are Table 8 strings, read as the modifiers, reported.
reasons.not-modelled|CATIA Geometric Set: CATIA-: UDA practice §6.3: shape aspects described 'CATIA Geometric Set' map CATIA's geometric sets and shall be ignored by other systems. Not PMI; reported, not read.
reasons.not-modelled|explicit geometry of the de: A derived feature (centre_of_symmetry, §5.1.4) also names its explicit geometry; the model holds the derivation (kind and base features), not this geometry.
reasons.not-modelled|property \"…\" (\"…\") is n: Property definitions on the part or its PMI that are neither PMI nor UDA constructs: specify-core's private 'pmi-assist answers' data, and CAD-system properties ('shape for solid data…', untyped '' properties). Reported, not read.
reasons.not-modelled|qualifier type_qualifier \": NIST CTC-05 qualifies the deviations of two toleranced dimensions (#990-#993) with TYPE_QUALIFIER('designed') #935 and #938 through MEASURE_QUALIFICATION #927-#930. The model's value holds a quantity and decimal places, not a type qualifier; the deviations are read, the qualifier is reported.
reasons.not-modelled|the datum reference frame's: NIST STC-07 gives datum systems an axis placement by a usage (§6.9.7 Figure 64, for degree-of-freedom modifiers); the model's datum system holds its compartments and modifiers, not this placement.
reasons.unconsumed|not reached from any part's P: Semantic instances that no part's PMI reaches: qualifiers and measure qualifications on product definitions that are not parts (NIST FTC-09's shape-less product definitions), instances referenced by nothing (NIST CTC-05's TYPE_QUALIFIER('designed') #936, #937, #939, #940), and the tessellated-only FTC-08 e4 file's PMI (no B-rep part).
reasons.unconsumed|on a product definition that: PMI on a product definition the reader has no part for: NIST FTC-09's product definitions #30 and #8155 (no B-rep shape, no assembly relationship) and the tessellated-only FTC-08 e4 file (read_part_definitions refuses it). Not attributed to any part.
reasons.unconsumed|part of geometric_tolerance+g: Part of a tolerance that is not read (its toleranced feature identifies nothing).
reasons.unconsumed|part of shape_aspect N, which: The usage of a shape aspect that is not read (it identifies the whole MANIFOLD_SOLID_BREP, for a geometric validation property).
reasons.unresolved-reference|items that are not: A shape aspect identifying the whole solid (MANIFOLD_SOLID_BREP), used only by geometric validation properties; the model's features are faces, edges and supplemental geometry, so it is not read.
reasons.unresolved-reference|the referenced datu: NIST FTC-09 #11143 is toleranced on the second part's #9569 but cites datum system #9813 of the first part (general_datum_reference WR5): an assembly-level reference, not attributed to either part.
reasons.unresolved-reference|the toleranced feat: The tolerance's toleranced shape aspect identifies no geometry (e.g. NIST FTC-06 #348 on #2818), so there is nothing to tolerance.
